item.title: Hinckley & Other Departments Train
item.description: The Hinckley Fire Department, in partnership with neighboring departments, conducted intensive training sessions at Caddyshack and Buzzards Roost. The training focused on vertical ventilation, window-door conversion, overhaul, and roof ladder operations. The value of this training is undeniable. item.title: Two Deer Rescued from Harrison Lake
item.description: The Gorham-Fayette FD received a call regarding two deer stuck in the middle of the ice at Harrison Lake. Crews was able to rescue both deer; one took off right away and the other just needed a little warming effort. – Photos courtesy of Gorham-Fayette FD

item.description: At 0127 hours, the Warren City Fire Department was dispatched to the 1200 block of Taylor Street NW for a report of a fully involved structure fire. item.title: Quick Response Limits Damage in Coshocton House Fire
item.description: The Coshocton Fire Department swiftly contained a house fire on January 13, 2026, preventing extensive damage thanks to its prime location and rapid response. item.title: Cleveland Responds to 2 in 1 Day
item.description: Cleveland firefighters recently battled two fires at once. Battalion 6 had an apartment fire on East Boulevard, south of Superior, while Battalion 4 battled a house fire on Pilsen Avenue. No injuries were reported. Cold temps made for icy conditions on the fire ground. – Photos courtesy of Cleveland FD
